answers.arbitrary_execution_step: Rejected by strict TOOL, AGENT, CONDITION, and NOOP discriminated contracts; SHELL, SQL, URL, CRON, CAMPAIGN, and HUMAN_QUEUE are invalid.
answers.condition_contradiction: One claim token can persist one deterministic condition result; duplicate completion is fenced.
answers.cross_tenant_reference: Forced RLS and tenant-aware composite foreign keys reject it.
answers.definition_mutates_active_run: No; each run binds to an immutable published version protected by database triggers.
answers.external_effect_then_local_failure: The durable claim and stable P08/P13 semantic identity preserve ambiguity; no automatic redispatch occurs.
answers.p08_bypass: No; TOOL dispatch has only the injected ToolEngine boundary and no URL or credential contract.
answers.p13_bypass: No; AGENT dispatch has only the injected AgentService boundary and no provider contract.
answers.p25_deferral: Automatic orphan reaping, lease reassignment, ambiguous-effect reconciliation, crash recovery, and failover remain deferred.
answers.paused_after_cancelled: Impossible; CANCELLED is absorbing and resume requires PAUSED under the same run-row lock.
answers.retry_side_effect: P08 uses one stable semantic key per run/step; physical exactly-once is not claimed and ambiguity remains fenced.
answers.stale_after_cancel: Cannot claim or commit; cancellation and claims serialize on the run row and terminal writes require current owner/token.
answers.stale_owner_completion: Rejected by state, owner, and claim-token compare-and-set.
answers.terminal_resurrection: Rejected by transition guards and absorbing terminal states.
answers.two_replica_execution: Only one READY-to-RUNNING claim commits; the loser receives no execution authority.
